lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns of 3 to 5 nodes, positioned between the longitudinal carinae on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with light values on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark irregular notch or lesion visible on the posterior-distal margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, elongated dark feature (potential remora) attached to the upper dorsal-lateral surface.
